title: skill-guard: direct .skill.json edit blocked
desc: Guard that blocks direct Edit/Write on .skill.json files. Fires when AI tries to bypass the skill catalog by editing files directly.
steps: SAFETY: Catches direct .skill.json file edits via Edit/Write/Update tools, bypassing skill schema validation, version bumping, and catalog registration.
SOLUTION: Use 'wkappbot skill edit <id>' or 'wkappbot skill contribute' instead. They validate encoding, handle the pipe-separator, update the catalog, and bump version correctly.
PREVENTION: Never use Edit/Write tool on any *.skill.json path. The
character is the step separator in skill files -- a raw edit that contains
will corrupt the step list silently.
